name: micrometer
description: An outside micrometer with a curved frame, anvil, spindle and thimble.
useCase: Identify an outside micrometer for precise dimensional measurement.
misuse: Use caliper for sliding jaws on a straight measuring beam.

16.reason: The complete curved frame surrounds a visible measuring gap beside the full thimble.

24.reason: The larger frame retains the full anvil, spindle, thimble and open measuring gap.
